spells.name: Big Kick
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy and kicks them 2 tiles back.

spells.name: Cryptid Vanish
spells.desc: Was it real? The photo's blurry... Teleport 2 tiles, invisible 2 turns.

spells.name: Entangling Roots
spells.desc: The ground remembers what it grew. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to All Enemies in a 3×3 and Roots them for a round.

spells.name: Sasquatch Smash
spells.desc: Deals HEAVY physical damage to a Single Enemy. The photo would have been blurry anyway. Deals bonus damage to Staggered targets.

spells.name: Herbal Remedy
spells.desc: Restores a BIG amount of HP to a Single Ally and cleanses 2 debuffs.

spells.name: Thornlash
spells.desc: A bramble whip wraps the legs. WEAK physical damage to a Single Enemy and Roots it for 1 round.

spells.name: Love Bite
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Lowers the target's DEF by 1 stage.

spells.name: Nimble Dodge
spells.desc: Gracefully dash 3 tiles away and vanish for 1 turn. Perfect evasive maneuver. Needs 2 rounds between dodges.

spells.name: Meow
spells.desc: An adorable, disarming meow. All enemies within 2 tiles have their DEF lowered for 3 rounds. Deals no damage.

spells.name: Ninefold Scratch
spells.desc: Nine lives, nine scratches. Deals SEVERE physical damage to a Single Enemy across 9 hits.

spells.name: Sprint
spells.desc: Go. Runs up to 3 tiles in a straight line.
Dashes through the battlefield. Applies Stagger. The caster charges into melee first.
spells.name: Ram Charge
Transform
spells.desc: Stand up into the combat platform: −3 SPD, +1 DEF and +2 M DEF stages, +2 RNG. Or fold back down.

spells.name: Hydraulic Crush
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage to Jammed or Staggered targets.

spells.name: Vehicular Manslaughter
spells.desc: It was an accident. Four times. Drives through every enemy in the lane for HEAVY physical damage. Deals bonus damage to Discorded targets.

spells.name: Hydraulic Punch
spells.desc: Deals WEAK physical damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage to targets with Jammed. Knocks the target back 2 tiles.

spells.name: Exhaust Cloud
spells.desc: Pump toxic exhaust in a 3x3 cloud for 2 turns. Enemies inside are confused.

spells.name: Swing Door
spells.desc: Mind the door. Shoot a door onto an EMPTY tile beside an enemy within 3 — the hinge — and it swings through them: WEAK physical damage, Staggered, and they are pushed 2 tiles straight away from the hinge. Pick the hinge on the far side and you pick where they land.

spells.name: Breaking and Entering
spells.desc: Nobody said the door had to be yours. Shoot a door down beside an enemy within 4 tiles you can see and come through it: WEAK physical damage, always a rear attack.

spells.name: Underdog Spirit
spells.desc: Nobody believed in you. Good. Raises the caster's ATK by 2 stages and cleanses a debuff.

spells.name: Drop In
spells.desc: Uninvited. Shoot a door into the air over an enemy within 5 tiles you can see and drop out of it onto them: HEAVY physical damage, always a rear attack, worse on a Staggered target, and every other enemy beside the landing takes WEAK physical damage from the slam.

spells.name: Elbow Grease
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. No tricks, no magic — just honest work.

spells.name: Air Mail
spells.desc: Return to sender. Shoot a door at an enemy within 4 tiles: they go in, and a door opens three storeys over their head for them to fall out of. MEDIUM physical damage from the landing, flyers are grounded, the target is Staggered.

spells.name: Door Dash
spells.desc: Take the short cut. Shoot a door onto an empty tile within 5, step into a door at your feet and out of that one. No damage, no opportunity strikes — you were never in between.

spells.name: Elbow Grease
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. No tricks, no magic — just honest work.

spells.name: Rocket Fist
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Knocks the target back 2 tiles. Upgrades: Efficient (−10 MP (never below 5)), Empowered (+15 % damage).

spells.name: Grapple Arm
spells.desc: The forearm fires on a cable. Deals WEAK physical damage to a Single Enemy within 4 tiles, reels it 3 tiles toward you and Staggers it.

spells.name: To the Moon
spells.desc: Grabs the target, rockets skyward and hurls them AT THE MOON. The moon loses. Deals HEAVY physical damage plus the fall, more if the landing crushes another unit; the moon's debris rains on the landing. Caster must be flying. Upgrades: Efficient (−10 MP (never below 5)).

spells.name: Plasma Cannon
spells.desc: The arm morphs into a cannon and fires a beam two tiles wide. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to All Enemies in the line. Applies Burn.

spells.name: 5G Tower
spells.desc: Deploy a 5G radio tower (3 hits to destroy). Its signal scrambles thought — enemies within 4 tiles lose 8 M DEF while it stands. Max 1 per Engineer. Upgrades: Surplus (+1 deployable active at once (on a door row: the shared standing-door cap 2 → 3)).

spells.name: Tesla Coil
spells.desc: Deploy an electrified coil. Detonates when an enemy steps on it. 3×3 shock damage. Placing on an empty tile never ends your turn or uses your spell slot; throwing it directly onto an enemy shocks them on contact and ends your turn.

spells.name: Garden Shears
spells.desc: Snip. Deals SEVERE physical damage to a Single Enemy beside you. Deals bonus damage to Slowed targets. Upgrades: Efficient (−10 MP (never below 5)).

spells.name: Free Energy
spells.desc: Restores 40 MP to All Allies.

spells.name: Splash
spells.desc: Burst outward. Deals WEAK magic damage to All Enemies in the 3×3 around you and Goos them; the whole 3×3 turns to ooze for 3 rounds.

spells.name: Corrosive Splash
spells.desc: Deals WEAK magic damage to All Enemies in an AOE. Applies Poison.

spells.name: Infectious Bite
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Applies Poison. Upgrades: Blast (A 3×3 burst round the victim: every enemy next to it takes half damage).

spells.name: Great Flood
spells.desc: Call the drowned deep. Water pours into the target tile and RISES to fill the surrounding basin (up to 12 tiles) — meteor craters and trenches flood to the rim, chasms become deep water. Enemies caught take HEAVY magic damage, are slowed, and can start to drown. Flyers up in the sky are above it.

spells.name: Out of the Dark
spells.desc: One clear look. That was the last photo on the roll. Charges up to 3 tiles and deals SEVERE physical damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage to Feared targets.

spells.name: Luminous Shield
spells.desc: Grants a damage-absorbing shield to All Allies in an AOE. Upgrades: Long Reach (+1 range).

spells.name: Protect
spells.desc: Empowers a Single Ally. Applies Protect. Cooldown: 3 rounds.

spells.name: Heal All
spells.desc: Restores a MEDIUM amount of HP to All Allies.

spells.name: Blessing
spells.desc: Bless a Single Ally for 3 rounds: +1 DEF stage, +1 M DEF stage, and 40 HP restored at the end of every round.

spells.name: Hallelujah
spells.desc: The choir answers. Restores a LARGE amount of HP to All Allies and cleanses 2 debuffs from each.

spells.name: Holy Water
spells.desc: The power of Christ compels you. Deals WEAK magic damage to a Single Enemy within 3, more to Unholy and Anomaly targets, and Soaks them for 2 rounds.
